settings.tab_content: Harvested from responsibly managed North American walnut forests. Features highly active, unique grain patterns waxed to standard satin finish.
Built with mortise & tenon wood joints to eliminate structural creaks or joint separation over decades of heavy family usage.
Fitted with silent floor guards underneath solid wood legs. Prevents scratch marks on luxury parquet, marble, or hardwood floors.
Treated with micro-seal protective barriers. Spills bead up instantly instead of soaking deep into organic flax fibers.
